run_basic_sweep: run the basic_sweep function to generate EnsembleConfig objects for num_ensemble values 1, 3, 10, 30, 100
run_boot_sweep: run the boot_sweep function to generate EnsembleConfig objects for distribution values none, bernoulli, exponential
run_weight_decay_sweep: run the weight_decay_sweep function to generate EnsembleConfig objects for l2_weight_decay values 0.1, 0.3, 1, 3, 10
run_prior_scale_sweep: run the prior_scale_sweep function to generate EnsembleConfig objects for temp_scale_prior and prior_scale combinations
run_combined_sweep: run the combined_sweep function to generate a combined sequence of all EnsembleConfig sweeps
